name: desafio-gcp-zap
description: Sistema de Gestão e Disparos Inteligentes de WhatsApp com Firebase e React

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "FUNCTIONS:WATCH,EMULATORS,WEB:VITE" -c "yellow.bold,blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix functions run dev" "firebase emulators:start --project desafio-gcp-zap" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
